debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

log_level.description: Minimum logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

pid_dir.description: Directory to store PID files for running Carbon instances.

log_dir.description: Directory where Carbon log files are written.

max_cache_size.description: Maximum number of metrics to hold in memory per cache instance.

flush_interval.description: How often (in seconds) the cache is flushed to disk.

flush_count.description: Number of parallel threads used to write data to disk.

enable_udp_listener.description: Enable listening for metrics via UDP protocol in addition to TCP.

bind_address.description: Network interface IP to bind all Carbon receiver daemons to.

instances.description: List of Carbon cache instances to run. Each instance runs independently on its own ports.

enabled.description: Whether this instance should be started.

port.description: TCP port to listen on for plaintext Line protocol metrics.

pickle_port.description: TCP port to listen on for Pickle protocol metrics.

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent TCP connections allowed for this instance.

storage_dir.description: Directory where Whisper database files for this instance are stored.

aggregation.description: Enable metric aggregation for this instance (used only for aggregator instances).

aggregation_intervals.description: Aggregation intervals (e.g., 10, 60, 300 seconds) if aggregation is enabled.
